items.title: Eddie Alley interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: Oh my goodness. Jerome played with me a lot of gigs. I love Jerome Richardson.

ctx.x: Oh my goodness. Jerome played with me a lot of gigs. I love Jerome Richardson.
He taught me a little phrase. We were doing this recording and we were rehearsing it a little bit and he goes, “Let’s make it — let’s make it.” So we made it.
